Industry volumes are expected to grow by approximately 10% during FY 2026 -27, following strong volume growth of more than 20% in the preceding fiscal year.

According to industry estimates, the Indian cable and wire market is expected to expand from approximately ₹1.1 lakh crore in FY2025 -26 to around ₹1.7 lakh crore by FY2029-30, representing a growth rate of approximately 12% annually.
